default
column2: ""adjustable clock""). The objective is to allow taprio/etf

column1: offloading to coexist with PTP vclocks.
Besides the implementation of .getcyclesx64() for i225/i226
timestamping working when vclocks are in use
support for TX and RX timestamping using the free running timer
the requesting socket is bound to a vclock.
On the RX side
column2: i225/i226 can be configured to store the values of two

column1: timers in the received packet metadata area
configuring the right registers and retrieving the right timestamp.
The TX is a bit more involved because the hardware stores a single
timestamp (with the selected timer in the TX descriptor) into one of
the timestamp registers.

conversion and adjustment of timestamps are now done closer to the
consumption of the timestamp instead of near the reception.
